newsitem.title: USA: Nemdaco says Dane is now CEO.
newsitem.headline: Nemdaco says Dane is now CEO.

text.p: Nemdaco Inc said Wednesday that it named William Daniel Dane as its chairman. He currently serves as president and also sits on the company's board of directors.

Dane, the company said, replaces Jeff Bender, who resigned as chairman and a member of the board for business and personal reasons. The company said that Bender will remain on the board of Nemdaco's subsidiaries and Nemdaco China Ventures Inc.
Nemdaco said Thomas Siciliano, the company's chief financial officer, has been appointed to the vacant seat on its board of directors created by Bender's resignation.
